TEXT: [FI] We somehow made it to the day of the tournament...
[FI] As usual, Kirino, Kuroneko, Saori and I set off to Akihabara as a group.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] By the way, you guys...
[FI] Everybody's sulking, what's with this gloomy atmosphere?
[FI] Wasn't that over a few days ago?
[FI] Isn't it about time their temper subsided?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hey, you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Eh? W-What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I am reluctantly gracing you with my presence in this tournament. Don't you have anything to say to me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] H-Huh!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I require gratitude as well as an apology.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Why must I do such a thing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Isn't it obvious? Why are you so stubborn?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Could it be that you couldn't take it because I stole your brother?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] W-What are you saying!? Impossible!
[FI] These two... Don't they know other ways to communicate?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha, both of you are really hyped up! We shall not lose either, Kyousuke-shi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No... Besides, how is this hyped up?
[FI] Right in front of me pointing my finger--

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Could you not decide things on your own?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Seriously, this chuunibyou-ridden girl is a real pain.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hehe. People who have said that to me no longer exist in this world.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Say, isn't it about time you realized how miserable your existence is?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] And who is always losing at Siscaly against said miserable existence?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Hng... If it's wasn't for me, you wouldn't be able to join this tournament either!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Furthermore, do you even have friends to team up with?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] T-That's...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Here we are!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Aren't the four of us all gathered here as fellows with a common purpose!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Pfft, quite...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Isn't now the time for us to unite our strength? The objective is to capture the rare prize!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Hmph...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I guess there's no helping it.
[FI] Phew... It seems like the situation has been defused.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Anyway, it seems like there's a lot of people.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Well, as long as there are prizes, collectors will definitely come.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hoh... A lot of people have free time on their hands.
[FI] Even if it's for the rare prize, people wouldn't normally go this far, right?
[FI] I probably wouldn't understand even if I spent an entire lifetime thinking about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Not only collectors will come, but I'm afraid experts like Kuroneko-shi are also bound to gather here.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] As a reminder, Siscaly is a 2 on 2 team battle, that's why teamwork is so important!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Heh, that's just a mere human's perspective.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi should muster up some enthusiasm too!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You must win!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Must...? Well, I'll try my best...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Be sure not to pull me down. Be careful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Yeah～
[FI] On a side note, the teams are "Kirino & Saori" and "Kuroneko & I".
[FI] Kirino and Kuroneko would certainly quarrel if they were in the same group, so this arrangement seems obvious.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Oh, looks like it's about to start.
[FI] Looking in the direction Saori pointed, an official-like person walked towards the crowd.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] It looks like the organizer sucks. An amateur?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] In tournaments of this scale, organizers are normally like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Professional organizers tend to handle larger game tournaments.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So there are larger game tournaments?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Of course. For famous fighting games like "Siscaly", there are even enthusiasts-driven tournaments.
[FI] I think "Siscaly" has enough enthusiasts...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] There are a lot of card game tournaments too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So there are even such things. Amazing...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Oh? Does Kyousuke-shi wants to join this community from now on?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Heh, kinda.
[FI] Though, well... I don't think it's a bad idea...
[FI] Somehow, I feel like I've been engulfed by the atmosphere of the place and my excitement is gradually raising.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] This competition is a single-elimination tournament.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Which means, it's the end if we lose here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmph...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] With that, everyone, let's do our best!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] We'll definitely win.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Well, since I am here, the word defeat is irrelevant.
[FI] T-These guys are really into it...
[FI] All right, I also have to do my best!
[FI] I can't let the time spent on special training go to waste!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] We must get that rare prize no matter what it takes--!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Oh---!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Oh---!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ---Heh.
[FI] And thus the competition began--
[FI] Kirino and Saori's group advanced smoothly. As for our pair, although I was in trouble at times, thanks to Kuroneko, we were able to advance as well.
[FI] However--
[FI] Even when you consider her transcendental reaction time, it seems impossible to fight with such an incompetent partner.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sorry, Kuroneko... I'm always dragging you down.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Since you're paired with me, it means we're riding the same Wyvern.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Isn't it "same boat"? But I'm counting on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Yeah, I will protect you, Senpai.
[FI] And like that, we advanced into the semi-finals.
[FI] And then, here--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Eh?
[FI] This is-- an unexpected situation...
[FI] Our opponents for the semi-finals ended up being Kirino & Saori!
[FI] What should we do? Have we no other choices than fight each other...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What should we do, Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Even if you ask me...
[FI] Putting me aside, letting them win might make it easier to win the finals...
[FI] But if we go easy on them in the battle...
[FI] Will the prideful Kuroneko permit such a plan?
[FI] Or will it be better if we have a serious match...
